attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Print Processors (T1547.012)
attackers_goals: Gain persistence using the legitimate windows print processor mechanism, which loads libraries into Windows services.
description: The endpoint registered a new print processor, which may be used to gain persistence on the host by loading libraries into the time management service.
investigative_actions: Verify if the registered library is malicious. Check if the installing software is a malicious binary. Check for any suspicious network activity from svchost.exe or spoolsv.exe.
name: Suspicious print processor registered
